<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Unsigned 8-bit multiplier implemented using pipelined processing.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal for chip reset.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal controlling multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplicand input signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplier input signal.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating if multiplication is enabled.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <state_name id="IDLE">State IDLE.</state_name>
        <state_name id="LOAD">State LOAD.</state_name>
        <state_name id="MULTIPLY">State MULTIPLY.</state_name>
        <state_name id="OUTPUT">State OUTPUT.</state_name>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="mul_en_out_reg" width_description="[1:0]">Register storing the input enable signal.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_a_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register storing the multiplicand.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_b_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register storing the multiplier.</reg>
        <reg id="temp[0]" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary storage for partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="temp[1]" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary storage for partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="temp[2]" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary storage for partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="temp[3]" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary storage for partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="temp[4]" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary storage for partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="temp[5]" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary storage for partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="temp[6]" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary storage for partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="temp[7]" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary storage for partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[0]" width_description="[15:0]">Sum register for first stage.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[1]" width_description="[15:0]">Sum register for second stage.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[2]" width_description="[15:0]">Sum register for third stage.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[3]" width_description="[15:0]">Sum register for fourth stage.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[4]" width_description="[15:0]">Sum register for fifth stage.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_out_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register storing the final product.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Register to hold the input enable signal
        reg [1:0] mul_en_out_reg;
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            // Update the input enable signal register on the positive edge of the clock
            mul_en_out_reg <= {mul_en_out_reg[0], mul_en_in};
        end
        
        // Assign the output enable signal based on the input enable signal register
        assign mul_en_out = mul_en_out_reg[1];
        
        // Register to hold the multiplicand
        reg [7:0] mul_a_reg;
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            // Update the multiplicand register on the positive edge of the clock
            if (mul_en_out_reg[0]) begin
                mul_a_reg <= mul_a;
            end
        end
        
        // Register to hold the multiplier
        reg [7:0] mul_b_reg;
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            // Update the multiplier register on the positive edge of the clock
            if (mul_en_out_reg[0]) begin
                mul_b_reg <= mul_b;
            end
        end
        
        // Generate partial products based on the multiplier bits
        genvar i;
        generate
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : gen_partial_products
                assign temp[i][7:0] = (mul_b_reg[i]) ? mul_a_reg : 8'h00;
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Calculate partial sums based on the generated partial products
        genvar j;
        generate
            for (j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin : gen_partial_sums
                if (j == 0) begin
                    assign sum[j][15:0] = temp[j][15:0];
                end else begin
                    assign sum[j][15:0] = sum[j-1][15:0] + temp[j][15:0];
                end
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Final product calculation
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            mul_out_reg <= sum[7][15:0];
        end
        
        // Assign the output product based on the output enable signal
        assign mul_out = (mul_en_out_reg[1]) ? mul_out_reg : 16'h0000;
    </implementation>
</module>
